facts.fact: The Fonds d'Intervention pour le Développement (FID) issued a national open tender on 11 July 2024, closing 8 August 2024, for QR-code payment of cash transfers on the PGP platform for the FIAVOTA programme under the World Bank-financed Safety Nets and Resilience Project, in eight lots across Anosy and Androy.

MDG.note: Communes are only payment locations in a tender; no office connection stated.
Tender is for a payment service; no programme management information system is described.
